images.title: Tokens on a place value table
images.purpose: Show how tokens read as a number: tokens sit in their columns and the number is written below.
images.composition: A place value table of five columns with token stacks above each column and the number 11,214 written below.
images.exact_structure: Five columns left to right with headers TTh, Th, H, T, O. Token stacks sitting above the headers: TTh column has 1 large round token marked 10,000; Th column has 1 round token marked 1,000; H column has 2 round tokens marked 100; T column has 1 small round token marked 10; O column has 4 small round tokens marked 1. Tokens in each column have the colour of that column header: TTh #CC79A7, Th #0072B2, H #009E73, T #E69F00, O #6B7280. Below the headers one row of digits: 1, 1, 2, 1, 4. Below that, the number 11,214 written large with the words 'Eleven thousand two hundred fourteen' under it.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Count the tokens in each column, then write the digit, the comma and the name.
